basic_info.description: Nestled in the sunny part of San Francisco, this three-level home features four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms has been fully renovated down to the studs. The renovation includes a new foundation, updated electrical and plumbing systems, new central heating and air conditioning, dual-pane windows, a new roof, new flooring throughout, and recessed lighting for a modern look. The main level includes two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a contemporary kitchen with new cabinetry, countertops, and stainless steel appliances. The top level offers a large family room with ample natural light and a third bedroom. On the ground level, there is a fourth bedroom, one full bathroom, one half bathroom, and a second living room or office space with private access suitable for use as an in-law unit. The spacious backyard has been redesigned for low upkeep and features a newly installed fence for added privacy. Located near San Bruno Avenue shops and restaurants, the 3rd Street T-line light rail with convenient access to Highway 101, and just minutes away from Downtown San Francisco.
